layers.paint: Palette keys: which of the theme's fourteen colours the element wears.
layers.material: How the surface is made: finish, grain, edge light, depth, artwork. Picked from the approved recipes in theme-materials.css.
layers.motion: How it moves. Continuous motions are ambient; hover, press and enter answer the user; equip plays once when the theme is put on.

limits.rule: lift and grain are the most text colour (per cent) a recipe lays over a surface; the validator checks text and quiet text against that worst point. foilStops are the lightest and darkest mixes a foil gradient takes of its fill; its label must read on both. At most one continuous motion (listed in continuous) per theme; the rest answer the user or play once.

palette.covers: Every colour on every screen. The money colours (income, expense, transfer) are reserved: the app keeps its own.
palette.rule: Semantic colours only; income/expense/transfer remain distinguishable and labelled.

brand.covers: The two-leaf mark in the sidebar and the phone bar.
brand.rule: Approved light/dark mark only. Preserve identity, aspect ratio, dimensions and accessible name.

ground.covers: The page behind everything: PC main area and sidebar backdrop, phone screen.
ground.rule: Behind all content and never under a figure's own surface. Texture is drawn in the text colour; artwork in the accent, mirrored in Arabic.

header.covers: PC top bar under the page title; phone app bar.
header.rule: Paint only; preserve header height, controls and navigation order.

navigation.covers: PC sidebar and its current page; phone tab bar and its current tab.
navigation.rule: Preserve routes, labels, order, hit targets and selected/focus states.

hero.covers: The lead figure: Overview's net worth card, the focal metric cards, portfolio summary; on the phone, the lead figure's ground.
hero.rule: Never alter amounts, formatting, text colour meaning or figure position. Artwork sits in the far corner, away from the figure.

cards.covers: Cards, panels, KPI tiles, overview blocks and list groups; phone cards and KPI tiles. Their borders also draw list dividers.
cards.rule: Keep padding, shape, border width, row heights, reading order and content.

charts.covers: Chart grid lines and nonfinancial chart accents.
charts.rule: Preserve financial series meaning, axes, labels and non-colour distinctions.

controls.covers: Primary buttons, the chosen filter chip, the phone Add disc, and the focus ring everywhere.
controls.rule: Keep dimensions, keyboard behaviour, validation and disabled/error states.

buttons.covers: Secondary and small buttons, the date picker button.

tabs.covers: Period switch, section tabs, segmented controls; on the phone, segments and filter rows.
tabs.rule: Keep order, labels and the chosen state's meaning.

fields.covers: Text inputs, selects, pickers and search fields.
fields.rule: Soft wells (A16): never white or boxed on a dark theme. Keep size, validation and error states.

progress.covers: Budget meters, plan bullets, KPI meters.
progress.rule: The fill keeps its meaning colour; only the track and the finish change.

overlays.covers: Dialogs, pop-ups, phone sheets and the period panel, and the shade behind them.
overlays.rule: Keep stacking, modal focus containment, dismiss behaviour and screen-reader labels.

menus.rule: Keep menu contents, order, keyboard access and hit targets.
